rules.title: A Conditional Access policy blocks legacy authentication clients of type 'other' for all users and apps
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA requires legacy authentication to be blocked. This part checks that an enabled Conditional Access policy blocks the 'Other clients' (legacy protocols) client app type for all users and all cloud apps. The Exchange ActiveSync part is checked by ENTRA.CISA.1.1b.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > create a policy: Users All users, Target resources All resources, Conditions > Client apps > Other clients (legacy authentication clients), Grant > Block access. Enable the policy.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy blocks Exchange ActiveSync clients for all users and apps
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA requires legacy authentication to be blocked. This part checks that an enabled Conditional Access policy blocks Exchange ActiveSync clients for all users and all cloud apps (the 'other' clients part is checked by ENTRA.CISA.1.1a).
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > create a policy: All users, All resources, Conditions > Client apps > Exchange ActiveSync clients, Grant > Block access. Enable the policy.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy blocks users detected as high risk
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: Users that Entra ID Protection detects as high risk are likely compromised. An enabled policy for all users and all apps must block access for high user risk.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > create a policy: All users, All resources, Conditions > User risk = High, Grant > Block access. Enable the policy.

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy enforces phishing-resistant MFA for all users and apps
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA requires phishing-resistant MFA for all users. This checks for an enabled policy covering all users and all apps that requires the built-in 'Phishing-resistant MFA' authentication strength.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > policy for All users and All resources > Grant > Require authentication strength > Phishing-resistant MFA. Enable the policy once users have registered FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business or certificate-based authentication.
rules.impact: Users without a phishing-resistant method registered are blocked until they register one.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy requires MFA for all users and apps
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: If phishing-resistant MFA is not enforced, CISA requires another MFA method for all users. This checks for an enabled policy for all users and all apps that requires MFA (grant control or an authentication strength that satisfies MFA; phishing-resistant strengths also satisfy it).
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > policy for All users and All resources > Grant > Require multifactor authentication (or an authentication strength). Enable the policy.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy requires phishing-resistant MFA for all highly privileged roles
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA lists eight highly privileged roles (Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, Privileged Authentication Administrator, Security Administrator, Exchange Administrator, SharePoint Administrator, Conditional Access Administrator and Intune Administrator). An enabled policy for all apps must include all of them and require the 'Phishing-resistant MFA' authentication strength.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > policy targeting Directory roles (all highly privileged roles), All resources > Grant > Require authentication strength > Phishing-resistant MFA. Enable the policy.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy requires managed (compliant) devices for all users and apps
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA recommends requiring managed devices for authentication. An enabled policy for all users and all apps must require a compliant device (a policy that offers compliant or hybrid-joined device also counts).
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > policy for All users and All resources > Grant > Require device to be marked as compliant (optionally OR Require Microsoft Entra hybrid joined device).
rules.impact: Unmanaged devices lose access to cloud apps.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: A Conditional Access policy requires managed devices to register security information (MFA)
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: No Conditional Access policies were collected
rules.description: CISA recommends managed devices be required to register MFA. An enabled policy using the 'Register security information' user action for all users must require a compliant device (compliant or hybrid-joined also counts).
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > policy for All users, Target > User actions > Register security information > Grant > Require device to be marked as compliant.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: The admin consent workflow is enabled, notifies reviewers and has at least one reviewer
rules.name: id
rules.empty_message: Admin consent request policy was not collected
rules.description: An admin consent workflow lets users request access to apps they cannot consent to. CISA requires it to be enabled with at least one reviewer who is notified of requests.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions > Admin consent settings > Users can request admin consent = Yes, select reviewers, and enable email notifications to reviewers.

links.text: CISA SCuBA M365 Entra ID baseline

rules.title: User consent to apps accessing company data is not allowed for low-impact or legacy consent policies
rules.name: id
rules.description: Allowing users to consent to apps lets attackers phish consent grants. The default user role must not be assigned the built-in 'microsoft-user-default-low' or 'microsoft-user-default-legacy' app consent policies.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions > User consent settings > Do not allow user consent (or restrict to a custom policy for verified publishers and selected permissions as your organisation requires).

rules.title: Third-party storage services are restricted in Microsoft 365 on the web
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: The Microsoft 365 on the web service principal does not exist (treated as a failure, as in the source test)
rules.description: The 'Microsoft 365 on the web' service principal (appId c1f33bc0-bdb4-4248-ba9b-096807ddb43e) controls third-party storage in Office on the web. It must exist and be disabled so users cannot open or save files in third-party storage services.
rules.remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise apps > Microsoft 365 on the web (c1f33bc0-bdb4-4248-ba9b-096807ddb43e) > Properties > Enabled for users to sign-in = No. Create the service principal first if it does not exist.
